title: 大阪杯の後に・それでも走れ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City finishes her run in the Osaka Hai. The crowd is left in awe, but a persistent doubt weighs Gold City down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, her manager comes and suggests she stop running. Her performance today was unsightly and empty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I protest, arguing that Gold City has yet to say she wants to quit. Doing so would lead her to regret.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City declares she will decide her future for herself. She sets forth to try and fill that emptiness by the time the spring Tenno Sho comes around.
